title: Utility performance incentives docket
summary: At an October 2026 Public Utilities Commission (PUC) hearing, the public heard the commission must set performance-based incentives tying utility revenues to performance on or before January 1, 2027. The public may file comments at any time in a separate docket on utility performance incentives.
